# nginxproxymanager_dns_providers (Data Source)

The DNS providers NPM supports for Letsencrypt DNS challenges.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nginxproxymanager_dns_providers" "all" {}

# The credentials format NPM expects for Cloudflare
output "cloudflare_credentials" {
  value = one([for p in data.nginxproxymanager_dns_providers.all.providers : p.credentials if p.id == "cloudflare"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `providers` (Attributes List) The supported DNS providers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `credentials` (String) Example of the credentials the DNS provider expects in `dns_provider_credentials`.
- `id` (String) ID to use as `dns_provider` on a Letsencrypt certificate.
- `name` (String) Name of the DNS provider.
